title: Canonical tower triangle composites are diagonal scalar contractions
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $S$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Put $B_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ and $A_T=((B_n)_T)_n$, with quotient transitions, for schemes $T$ over $S$. Use the coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers] and their ordinary derived categories [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be comparison, and let $\mathscr C^+(T)$ be the full subcategory of $D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ whose every level has an etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], meaning it is isomorphic to $\nu_T^*L_n$ for some $L_n\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},B_n)$. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, $W=P\times_SP$, $q:P\to S$, $p_1,p_2:W\to P$, and let $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ be the diagonal [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Use the Tate twist, supported diagonal map $\delta_\bullet:\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$, and splitting traces $t_q,t_1,t_2$ of [det-sp-tower-classes]; here $t_i$ is the trace for $p_i$. Write $F=Rq_{*,\bullet}$ and $G=q_\bullet^*(-)(1)[2]$.
Use the canonical comparison isomorphisms and natural maps on $\mathscr C^+$ specified in [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons].
Write $\eta_M$ for the composite
$$M\simeq Rp_{2*,\bullet}\Delta_*M\simeq Rp_{2*,\bullet}(\Delta_*A_P\otimes^Lp_1^*M)\xrightarrow{Rp_{2*,\bullet}(\delta_\bullet\otimes1)}Rp_{2*,\bullet}(p_1^*M)(1)[2]\simeq GFM,$$
and $\varepsilon_K$ for
$$FGK\simeq K\otimes^LRq_{*,\bullet}(A_P(1)[2])\xrightarrow{1\otimes t_q}K,$$
where composition, projection and exchange are the canonical mate maps on the ringed topos of towers [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].
Let $\alpha_i:A_P\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{i*,\bullet}\Delta_*A_P$ be the direct-image composition identification for $p_i\Delta=1_P$, and set $c_i=t_i\circ Rp_{i*,\bullet}(\delta_\bullet)\circ\alpha_i$. For every $M\in\mathscr C^+(P)$ and $K\in\mathscr C^+(S)$ the following identities of actual tower-derived morphisms hold:
$$\varepsilon_{FM}\circ F(\eta_M)=F(1_M\otimes c_1),\qquad G(\varepsilon_K)\circ\eta_{GK}=1_{GK}\otimes c_2,$$
using the unit identifications $M\otimes^LA_P\simeq M$ and $GK\otimes^LA_P\simeq GK$.
In the first equality the expanded composite is
$$FM\simeq R(qp_1)_{*,\bullet}\Delta_*M\xrightarrow{R(qp_1)_*(\delta_\bullet\otimes1)}R(qp_1)_{*,\bullet}(p_1^*M(1)[2])\simeq F(M\otimes^LRp_{1*,\bullet}(A_W(1)[2]))\xrightarrow{F(1\otimes t_1)}FM.$$
Under projection its first arrow has the factor $1_M\otimes Rp_{1*,\bullet}(\delta_\bullet)$, including $\alpha_1$ on its source. In the second equality put $M=GK$; the canonical identifications $p_1^*M\simeq(qp_1)^*K(1)[2]\simeq p_2^*M$ identify the diagonal arrow with $1_M\otimes Rp_{2*,\bullet}(\delta_\bullet)$ and $G\varepsilon_K$ with contraction by the base-changed trace $t_2$. The reordering is with the canonical exchange/projection words, not unspecified isomorphisms. It uses the standard signed tensor symmetry: moving $[2]$ past degree $j$ has sign $(-1)^{2j}=1$, and interchanging the two copies of the unshifted rank-one twist has identity symmetry under the canonical multiplication identification. This statement does not assert $c_i=1$ or assume an adjunction $F\dashv G$.

proof.text: Factor eta definitionally as unitInsertion then unitTail by functoriality. Apply the diagonal-free first trace rearrangement; then the first diagonal transport equation moves pushSwap through the insertion. Functoriality of F gives the first expanded contraction.

For N=GK, factor eta_N as unitInsertion_N then unitTail_N. Apply the diagonal-free second trace rearrangement and then the second diagonal transport equation. This gives the second expanded contraction.

Section specialization gives diagonalInsertion = diagonalTensorFactor followed by outsideProjection, for either projection and every object in the domain. Prove outsideProjection followed by outsideLineProjectionInverse is identity by cancelling the pushed symmetry, projection and base symmetry in order, using h.projection_projections. Substitute in expandedContraction and combine the two tensor maps by functoriality. This is scalarContraction by diagonalScalar. Substitute into both expanded equations and retain the section-specialization equations as the last two clauses.
